snippet.title: Destructo Truck High Score: 1 Billion
snippet.description:
Same info as all my last vids... I just found a better system to do what i already was doing. This time it was really only refuel and Mammoth. Give it a try if you want. I am now on the world leaderboards at #29 for all time high scores.

I am sorry for the Destructo Truck Spamming....its just i am getting Higher and higher scores and i cant let people think that i am Only capable of scoring a Lowly 56 Mill! I got 1 Bill bitches!
